sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Elegant Rose Gold Tennis Bracelet Sparkling Marquise Crystal
sourceNotes.rawContent: Elevate your look with this stunning rose gold-toned tennis bracelet featuring a brilliant marquise solitaire. This high-fashion statement piece is perfect for effortless glamour. To preserve its radiant luster and shimmer, we recommend keeping it away from moisture and perfumes, and storing it safely in a dry place.
